searchText: That means we are back to having the problem of gas price estimation in wallets, which we are trying to get rid of. that's minimal now, is only a higher tip in case the user wants to transfer all there is left in a wallet. Any wallet that wants to enable a "sweep" would need to include gas estimation logic and deal with all of the problems of legacy transactions. That is a *lot* of complexity in a wallet just to enable a sweep EIPs need to be highly technical. First step is finding a champion that can take the time to shepherd it and who has the technical expertise to put it together.
